Hi,

I saw your opening for a Graphic Designer at MavnixIT and Marketing Services, and I wanted to reach out because your focus on high-converting social media creatives and ad campaigns matches my agency background.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I design over 100 digital and print assets, building reusable templates that cut turnaround time while working closely with stakeholders across marketing and management teams.

Since this role is based out of Nagpur, I am local and ready to start. Would you be open to a quick look at my social campaign work?

Ananya
